observation.model_behavior: Each invocation treated current_faction_id as ownership of the local modal, acknowledged an empty attention lease, and yielded WAITING without requesting a decision.
observation.supervisor_behavior: The third unchanged clean yield opened an operator-required incident and froze the campaign.

finding: current_faction_id owns ordinary turn actions. A phase=interaction modal belongs to the observing managed client and remains mandatory even when those faction IDs differ.

repair.runtime_context: Labels the interaction as a client_local_blocker, scopes current_faction_id to ordinary_turn_actions, and states that only phase=wait permits WAITING.
repair.fixed_doctrine: Adds the same bounded ownership rule to the sovereign interaction contract.
repair.resume_prompt: When authoritative progress is phase=interaction, every resumed episode explicitly calls for smac_decision and prohibits WAITING until a fresh decision reports phase=wait.
repair.circuit_breaker: Unchanged; three nonprogressing clean yields still require operator attention.

validation.wait_interaction_contract: passed in the MCP container environment

acceptance_limits: This fixture proves representation, provider instruction, and bounded supervision behavior.
Live dismissal, turn advancement, paired recovery safety, and sustained campaign stability remain deployment gates.
